parsed.name: 广播UDP RPC端口映射客户端
parsed.name_en: Broadcast UDP RPC Port Mapper Client
parsed.description: 用于通过 UDP 广播查询和使用 ONC/Sun RPC 端口映射服务的网络客户端组件。它可在局域网内发现提供 RPC 服务的主机与端口，并可进行端口映射查询、注册、注销和转发调用，适合实验室自动化系统定位网络化仪器服务或其他 RPC 服务端点。
parsed.description_en: A network client component for querying and using the ONC/Sun RPC port-mapper service via UDP broadcast. It can discover hosts and ports that provide RPC services on a local network, and supports port-mapping lookup, registration, unregistration, and forwarded calls, which is useful in laboratory automation for locating networked instrument services or other RPC service endpoints.
